# Azure OpenAI REST API Reference (image & audio, 2024-10-21 GA)
# (ms.date 2026-05-19; page updated 2026-06-24)

## API Versions
| API Surface | Latest Preview | Latest GA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Control Plane | 2025-07-01-preview | 2025-06-01 |
| Data Plane | v1 preview | v1 |

GA data plane inference spec documented: 2024-10-21.

## Supported Operations
1. Completions - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/completions
2. Chat Completions - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/chat/completions
3. Embeddings - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/embeddings
4. Audio Transcriptions - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/audio/transcriptions
5. Audio Translations - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/audio/translations
6. Image Generation - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/images/generations

## Key Features and Updates
- New Preview Inference API available (v1 preview) — see API lifecycle guide.
- Chat extensions (RAG) data sources: Azure Search, Azure Cosmos DB (MongoDB vCore)
- Structured Outputs (json_schema), tool/function calling (up to 128, parallel)
- Authentication: API Key (api-key header), Microsoft Entra ID (Bearer token)

Updated: 2026-07-04 — Same API version table as prior cache (Control plane 2025-07-01-preview / 2025-06-01 GA; Data plane v1 preview / v1 GA). No new endpoints or operations. No reportable addition.
